scope: Reference 01/04/05 comparison; all 10 contact-sheet and 128px alpha-background views; enlarged pumpkin, ghost, gift and basket; 300-dpi screen renders of all original PDFs.
referenceFinishAssessment: Substantially improved dimensional vector finish; exact reference art-style parity and final premium approval are not claimed.

independentAgentReview.scope: All ten illustrations at contact-sheet scale
independentAgentReview.finding: Clear improvement in volume, highlights and silhouettes. Gift perspective, apple slice and basket read clearly; no obvious drawing defects. Ghost cup/hand contour is slightly crowded at thumbnail scale. References remain richer/more varied in texture; do not claim exact style parity.

duplicateReview.formerPumpkinPair: Outline now uses a substantially distinct basket composition; former single-pumpkin overlap was eliminated.

items.note: Redrawn scalloped lobes; separate shadow surfaces, warm face planes, tapering contour details, folded leaf and modelled stem. Greater dimensional form than revision 1.
Redrawn robe; two visible hands cup the tea mug, with a visible drink surface, ceramic shading and separate holding-hand layers. Hand/cup contours remain dense at small thumbnail sizes.
Added wing membrane planes, fur highlights, side shadows and tiny feet while retaining the original friendly flying composition.
Added body shading and reflected light on all eight legs; eight legs remain distinct. Very dark preview backgrounds still reduce contrast.
Redrawn brighter organic apple surface with dimple, warm light and deep edge shadow. Slice now has red peel, flesh depth, core and two modelled seeds.
Petals have individually varied geometry and separate light planes. Layered seed disk and fine rim texture improve material depth.
Cap has overlapping vector scales and a defined rim, replacing the previous zigzag decoration. Shell has reflected warm light and directional shading.
Rebuilt as a coherent three-quarter box with visible lid thickness, top/front/side ribbon and curled bow surfaces with ribbon tails.
Added snow volume, hat light planes, knitted scarf marks and fringe details while preserving the friendly silhouette.

Completely redrawn as two differently shaped pumpkins in a woven harvest basket with a fallen acorn and oak leaf. Independent composition, not a line-only version of the other pumpkin. All print marks use pure K.
